text: {"thesis":"Earnings on 2026-02-25 makes RNVDAUSDT a binary event, so the primary risk is gap/slippage rather than normal intraday stop behavior. Price is already +4.4% over 5d and ~5.1% above sma20=186.68, so chasing long exposure here has poor reward/risk unless post-earnings confirmation appears. ATR14=5.68 (~2.9% of close) implies normal daily noise can span roughly 190.5-201.9, but an earnings gap can easily exceed 1-2x ATR. A defensible tactical stop would be 1.5-2.0x ATR below entry/reference, roughly 187.7-184.8, which also aligns with or below the 20-day SMA at 186.68; a close below that SMA on above-average volume would weaken any trend premise. Because stops may not fill near the level through an earnings gap, size using gap-adjusted risk, not just stop distance: risk no more than 0.25-0.5% of account equity, and assume a worst-case gap/slippage of 2-3x ATR (about 11.4-17.0 points, or ~6-9%) rather than the tighter stop. That implies a small starter position at most, no more than 0.5x normal size into the event; add only after post-earnings confirmation and a reclaim of SMA20. If already long, reduce into the print or hedge; do not average down if it gaps below 186.7.
